GetMongodbSlowQueryTemplate.fingerprintMd5: MD5 value of the SQL normalized fingerprint
GetMongodbSlowQueryTemplate.orderBy: Sort field, e.g. durationSum. Supported sort fields: executeTimes: number of executions; durationSum: total command execution time; durationMax: maximum command execution time; durationMin: minimum command execution time; durationAvg: average command execution time; keyScanRowsSum: total index scan rows; keyScanRowsMax: maximum index scan rows; keyScanRowsMin: minimum index scan rows; keyScanRowsAvg: average index scan rows; scanRowsSum: total scan rows; scanRowsMax: maximum scan rows; scanRowsMin: minimum scan rows; scanRowsAvg: average scan rows; returnRowsSum: total returned rows; returnRowsMax: maximum returned rows; returnRowsMin: minimum returned rows; returnRowsAvg: average returned rows
GetMongodbSlowQueryTemplate.order: Sort order, asc for ascending, desc for descending
GetMongodbSlowQueryTemplate.pageSize: Number of items per page, default is 20
